notes: This dataset contains the preprocessed traces of 35 test drives on the highway with two car-roof mounted Starlink dishes with active loss/delay measurements using ICMP. The dataset is described in the paper: The More We Measure, The Less We See: On the Replicability and Repeatability of Mobile Starlink Measurements. In 4th Workshop on LEOIn 4th Workshop on LEO Networking and Communication (LEO-NET ’26), August 17–21, 2026, Denver, CO, USA. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 6 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3789240.3827586
